prompt.text: Luca, a friend, has invited you for a coffee tomorrow morning. Write back: say you can't and why, and suggest another time.

exercises.correct_answer: Ciao Luca! Grazie, ma domani mattina non posso: devo lavorare. Vuoi prendere un caffè domani sera? Offro io! A presto.
hints: Non posso, devo + a verb. Then vuoi…? for the new suggestion.
